title: Talent Sourcing
summary: One search across your ATS, job boards, LinkedIn and referral pools.
headline: Every candidate source, *in one search*
lede: Describe the role once. TalentPool365 searches the database you already own alongside job boards and social channels, merges the duplicates and attaches every match to the requisition.

capabilities.title: AI Candidate Discovery
capabilities.body: Turn a plain-language role description into a ranked list of people who fit it, including those who never used your exact keywords.
points: Matches on skills and experience, not job titles
Each match shows why it surfaced
Runs again automatically as new profiles arrive

capabilities.title: Resume Database Search
capabilities.body: Semantic search over every resume your team has ever collected, so past applicants are the first place you look instead of the last.
points: Searches meaning, not just exact words
Filters for location, notice period and work rights
Finds silver medallists from earlier roles

capabilities.title: Job Board Integration
capabilities.body: Post to your boards from the requisition and pull applicants back into one pipeline, tagged with where they came from.
points: Publish to several boards in one step
Applicants land in the same queue
Source kept on every profile for reporting

capabilities.title: LinkedIn & Social Sourcing
capabilities.body: Bring passive candidates from LinkedIn and other professional networks into the same search, with outreach tracked next to the profile.
points: Outreach history visible to the whole team
No copy and paste into spreadsheets

capabilities.title: Talent Pool Management
capabilities.body: Group candidates into pools by skill, location or campaign and keep them warm, so the next requisition starts with a shortlist.
points: Consent and retention dates tracked per person

outcomes.label: channels searched at once, plus your own database
more qualified candidates reach the shortlist stage
record per person, however many sources found them
